headline: R-TYPE S1 'Armament' joins the arcade
lede: The forced-pod shooter shipped end-to-end on slot b: a DOM-free seeded engine with the cabinet's laws (right-only camera, one-hit death, gape-timed Phase-1 armour), 31 gate checks including an honest winnability proof, a named mutant that goes red on the maw law, and prod verified by chunk hash.

notes.text: R-TYPE S1 live at /retrogames/r-type (#2817, squash c329a97): capsule cycle with the 1–4 wave charge, pod-3 rescue, the dreadnought's 20-second maw cycle at the locked camera. rtypecheck 31/31 + mutant armour-blind proven red; contractcheck 15/15; soak rosters grown in the same commit.

Ports on this box answer for the wrong worktree: an orphaned vite on 5178 (and 5173) served another lane's code and would have let a browser gate pass against code it never built. New law for the next lane: before trusting a dev server, fetch src/games/<YourGame>/index.jsx from it and prove it's yours.

Mutant proofs in a scroller must force the threat into range before firing — shots despawn at the screen edge, so a naive fire-N-ticks mutant survives and the gate silently lies. The planted armour-blind bug only confesses once the hull sits at fighting distance.

Date.now() >> 2 overflows ToInt32: sign bit set, % 2 gives −1, sprite array miss, drawImage throws on a quarter of frames. Sprite anim counters ride sim ticks or Math.floor, never raw shifts of wall-clock.
